en.err_version: This version of Orbit doesn't match the server. Update Orbit in Hariku's Extension Store.
en.err_banned: This character or connection is banned from the station.
en.err_bad_secret: The connection didn't identify itself properly.
en.err_name_characters: A name may only have letters and digits, and must start with a letter.
en.err_name_filtered: That name isn't allowed on the station. Please choose another.
en.err_name_reserved: The station uses that name itself. Please choose another.
en.err_name_taken: Someone on the station is already called {name}. Please choose another name.
en.err_bad_job: Choose a job: pilot, engineer, trader, scientist or security.
en.err_full: The station is full right now. Try again in a few minutes.
en.welcome_new: Welcome to Orbit Station, {name}! You're the station's newest {job}. Type help to see what you can do.
en.replaced: You've connected from somewhere else, so this connection is closing.
en.server_restart: The station's computer is restarting. Orbit will reconnect by itself in a moment.
en.slow_down: Easy, not so fast! Wait a moment.
en.unknown_command: The station's computer doesn't know that command.
en.unknown_text: I don't understand "{what}". Type help for the commands.
en.oops: Something went wrong on the station's computer. Try again.
en.help: Commands: look, go to a place, say something, whisper to someone, shout, smile, wave, laugh, who, inventory, give someone credits, describe me, work, missions, accept a mission, take, complete, prices, buy, sell.
en.arrive_join: {actor} appears, just back on the station.
en.arrive_new: {actor} arrives on the station for the very first time. Say hello!
en.in_flight: You're flying the Merpati! Wait until you land.
en.no_place: There's no place called {what} on the station.
en.no_way: You can't get there from here.
en.brief_said_alone: Nobody else is here to hear it.
en.whisper_yourself: Whispering to yourself? Try saying it instead.
en.no_player: Nobody called {name} is on the station.
en.shout_wait: Your voice needs a rest: you can shout again in {time}.
en.no_emote: The station doesn't know that gesture.
en.who_flying: flying a cargo run to the Moon
en.give_self: You can't give things to yourself.
en.bad_number: That's not a number I can use.
en.give_credits_other: {actor} gives you {n} credits. You now have {credits}.
en.give_credits_self: You give {name} {n} credits. You have {credits} left.
en.describe_none: You haven't described yourself yet. Type describe me, then a few words.
en.work_none: There's no shift for a {job} yet: that comes in a later version. Try the mission board meanwhile: type missions.
en.work_cooldown: You've just worked. Take a break: you can work again in {time}.
en.repair_start: The reactor hums out of tune. Listen to the {n} stabiliser tones: {codes}. Repeat them by typing the numbers.
en.answer_nothing: There's nothing to answer right now.
en.repair_ok: The reactor purrs, steady again. You're paid {pay} credits; you have {credits}. Next shift in {time}.
en.repair_wrong: Wrong sequence: it was {codes}. The reactor coughs, and the supervisor sighs. Try again in {time}.
en.repair_late: Too slow: the backup system took over the reactor. Try again in {time}.
en.flight_depart_other: {actor} climbs into the Merpati, and the shuttle undocks for the Moon.
en.flight_depart: Clamps released. The Merpati pulls away from the station towards Moon Base Tranquility. The flight takes about {time}; you can still whisper and shout while you fly.
en.flight_half: Halfway there. The Moon fills the window now, grey and full of craters.
en.flight_arrive: Touchdown at Moon Base Tranquility. The cargo is unloaded, and the autopilot brings you back to the station. You're paid {pay} credits; you have {credits}. Next run in {time}.
en.flight_settled: While you were away, your cargo run landed: {pay} credits paid, and you have {credits}.
en.flight_back_other: The Merpati docks with a clunk, and {actor} climbs out.
en.trader_cheap: Good to buy: {good}, {pct} percent below the usual price.
en.trader_dear: Good to sell: {good}, {pct} percent above the usual price.
en.trader_calm: Prices are close to usual. Wait for them to move: they change every few minutes.
en.prices: Market prices in credits, for one each: {entries}. Traders get better prices, and prices change every few minutes.
en.prices_trader: Market prices in credits, for one each, at your trader's rates: {entries}. Prices change every few minutes.
en.bag_full: Your bag holds at most {max} goods.
en.buy_poor: That costs {total} credits, and you have {credits}.
en.buy_ok: You buy {things} for {total} credits. You have {credits} left.
en.sell_none: You don't have any {thing} to sell.
en.sell_ok: You sell {things} for {total} credits. You now have {credits}.
en.missions_board: Today's missions: {entries}. Type accept and a number.
en.mission_number: Which mission? Give a number from 1 to {count}.
en.mission_busy: You're already on a mission: {title}. Finish it, or type abandon mission.
en.mission_done_already: You've done that one today. Try another.
en.mission_accepted: Mission accepted: {title}. Pick them up {where} with take.
en.mission_none: You're not on a mission. Type missions to see the board.
en.take_buy: Goods like that are bought at the market: type buy.
en.take_enough: You have all you need. Now take them to {place} and type complete.
en.take_ok: You pick up {things} ({have} of {need}). Deliver them to {place}.
en.complete_missing: You have {have} of {need}. Get the rest {where}.
en.mission_complete: Mission complete: {title}. You're paid {pay} credits; you have {credits}.
en.not_admin: Only the station's admins can do that.
en.muted_you: An admin has muted you for {time}.
en.kicked_you: An admin has sent you off the station for now.
en.banned_you: An admin has banned you from the station.
en.earth_below_day: Right below us is {place}, in bright daylight: {view}.
en.earth_below_night: Right below us is {place}, at night: {view}.
en.earth_below_dawn: Right below us, dawn is breaking over {place}.
en.earth_below_dusk: Right below us, the sun is setting over {place}.
en.earth_edge_dawn: On the edge of night, dawn is breaking over {place}.
en.earth_edge_dusk: On the edge of night, the sun is setting over {place}.

id.err_version: Versi Orbit ini tidak cocok dengan server. Perbarui Orbit di Toko Ekstensi Hariku.
id.err_banned: Karakter atau sambunganmu dilarang masuk stasiun.
id.err_bad_secret: Sambungan ini tidak mengenalkan diri dengan benar.
id.err_name_characters: Nama hanya boleh berisi huruf dan angka, dan harus diawali huruf.
id.err_name_filtered: Nama itu tidak diizinkan di stasiun. Pilih nama lain, ya.
id.err_name_reserved: Nama itu dipakai stasiun sendiri. Pilih nama lain, ya.
id.err_name_taken: Sudah ada yang bernama {name} di stasiun. Pilih nama lain, ya.
id.err_bad_job: Pilih pekerjaan: pilot, insinyur, pedagang, ilmuwan, atau petugas keamanan.
id.err_full: Stasiun sedang penuh. Coba lagi beberapa menit lagi.
id.welcome_new: Selamat datang di Stasiun Orbit, {name}! Kamu {job} terbaru di stasiun ini. Ketik bantuan untuk melihat apa saja yang bisa kamu lakukan.
id.replaced: Kamu tersambung dari tempat lain, jadi sambungan ini ditutup.
id.server_restart: Komputer stasiun sedang dimulai ulang. Orbit akan tersambung lagi sendiri sebentar lagi.
id.slow_down: Pelan-pelan, jangan terlalu cepat! Tunggu sebentar.
id.unknown_command: Komputer stasiun tidak kenal perintah itu.
id.unknown_text: Aku tidak paham "{what}". Ketik bantuan untuk daftar perintah.
id.oops: Ada yang salah di komputer stasiun. Coba lagi.
id.help: Perintah: lihat, pergi ke suatu tempat, bilang sesuatu, bisik ke seseorang, teriak, senyum, lambai, tertawa, siapa, tas, beri kredit ke seseorang, deskripsi aku, kerja, misi, ambil misi, ambil, selesaikan misi, harga, beli, jual.
id.look_alone: Tidak ada orang lain di sini.
id.arrive_new: {actor} baru pertama kali datang ke stasiun. Sapa, yuk!
id.in_flight: Kamu sedang menerbangkan Merpati! Tunggu sampai mendarat.
id.no_place: Tidak ada tempat bernama {what} di stasiun.
id.no_way: Dari sini tidak ada jalan ke sana.
id.say_alone: Kamu bilang: {words} (tidak ada orang lain di sini)
id.brief_said_alone: Tidak ada orang lain yang mendengar di sini.
id.whisper_yourself: Berbisik ke diri sendiri? Coba bilang saja.
id.no_player: Tidak ada yang bernama {name} di stasiun.
id.shout_wait: Suaramu perlu istirahat: kamu bisa berteriak lagi dalam {time}.
id.who_flying: sedang terbang mengantar kargo ke Bulan
id.give_self: Kamu tidak bisa memberi dirimu sendiri.
id.describe_none: Kamu belum menulis deskripsi dirimu. Ketik deskripsi aku, lalu beberapa kata.
id.work_none: Belum ada shift untuk {job}: itu datang di versi berikutnya. Sementara itu coba papan misi: ketik misi.
id.work_where: Tempat kerjamu {where}: ke sana dulu, ya.
id.work_cooldown: Kamu baru saja kerja. Istirahat dulu: kamu bisa kerja lagi dalam {time}.
id.repair_start: Reaktor berdengung sumbang. Dengarkan {n} nada penstabil: {codes}. Ulangi dengan mengetik angkanya.
id.answer_nothing: Tidak ada yang perlu dijawab sekarang.
id.repair_ok: Reaktor mendengkur tenang lagi. Kamu dibayar {pay} kredit; kreditmu {credits}. Shift berikutnya dalam {time}.
id.repair_wrong: Urutannya salah: seharusnya {codes}. Reaktor terbatuk, dan mandor menghela napas. Coba lagi dalam {time}.
id.repair_late: Terlalu lama: sistem cadangan mengambil alih reaktor. Coba lagi dalam {time}.
id.flight_depart_other: {actor} naik ke Merpati, dan pesawat itu lepas landas menuju Bulan.
id.flight_depart: Penjepit dilepas. Merpati menjauh dari stasiun menuju Pangkalan Bulan Tranquility. Perjalanannya sekitar {time}; kamu masih bisa berbisik dan berteriak selama terbang.
id.flight_half: Sudah setengah jalan. Bulan sekarang memenuhi jendela, abu-abu dan penuh kawah.
id.flight_arrive: Mendarat di Pangkalan Bulan Tranquility. Kargo sudah dibongkar, dan autopilot membawamu kembali ke stasiun. Kamu dibayar {pay} kredit; kreditmu {credits}. Penerbangan berikutnya dalam {time}.
id.flight_settled: Selama kamu pergi, penerbangan kargomu sudah mendarat: dibayar {pay} kredit, dan kreditmu {credits}.
id.flight_back_other: Merpati bersandar dengan bunyi klunk, dan {actor} keluar.
id.trader_cheap: Bagus dibeli: {good}, {pct} persen di bawah harga biasa.
id.trader_dear: Bagus dijual: {good}, {pct} persen di atas harga biasa.
id.trader_calm: Harga-harga lagi normal. Tunggu sampai bergerak: harganya berubah tiap beberapa menit.
id.prices: Harga pasar dalam kredit, per satu: {entries}. Pedagang dapat harga lebih baik, dan harganya berubah tiap beberapa menit.
id.prices_trader: Harga pasar dalam kredit, per satu, dengan harga pedagangmu: {entries}. Harganya berubah tiap beberapa menit.
id.bag_full: Tasmu muat paling banyak {max} barang dagangan.
id.buy_ok: Kamu membeli {things} seharga {total} kredit. Sisa kreditmu {credits}.
id.sell_ok: Kamu menjual {things} seharga {total} kredit. Kreditmu sekarang {credits}.
id.missions_board: Misi hari ini: {entries}. Ketik ambil misi dan nomornya.
id.mission_number: Misi yang mana? Sebutkan nomor 1 sampai {count}.
id.mission_busy: Kamu masih mengerjakan misi: {title}. Selesaikan dulu, atau ketik batalkan misi.
id.mission_done_already: Misi itu sudah kamu selesaikan hari ini. Coba yang lain.
id.mission_accepted: Misi diterima: {title}. Ambil barangnya {where} dengan perintah ambil.
id.mission_none: Kamu sedang tidak menjalankan misi. Ketik misi untuk melihat papannya.
id.take_buy: Barang seperti itu dibeli di pasar: ketik beli.
id.take_enough: Barangnya sudah cukup. Sekarang bawa ke {place} dan ketik selesaikan misi.
id.complete_missing: Kamu baru punya {have} dari {need}. Ambil sisanya {where}.
id.mission_complete: Misi selesai: {title}. Kamu dibayar {pay} kredit; kreditmu {credits}.
id.not_admin: Hanya admin stasiun yang bisa melakukan itu.
id.kicked_you: Admin mengeluarkanmu dari stasiun untuk sementara.
id.earth_below_day: Tepat di bawah kita ada {place}, sedang siang terang: {view}.
id.earth_below_night: Tepat di bawah kita ada {place}, sedang malam: {view}.
id.earth_below_dawn: Tepat di bawah kita, fajar menyingsing di atas {place}.
id.earth_below_dusk: Tepat di bawah kita, matahari terbenam di atas {place}.
id.earth_edge_dawn: Di batas malam, fajar menyingsing di atas {place}.
id.earth_edge_dusk: Di batas malam, matahari terbenam di atas {place}.
